hooks.name: Security Check Review
hooks.description: Validate checks.js integrity whenever the security data file is saved

action.prompt: The file src/data/checks.js was just saved. Review the DEFAULT_CHECKS array and verify: (1) every check has a unique id in kebab-case, (2) every check has a non-empty explanation and recommendation, (3) every check's category is one of: Identity, Data, Network, Visibility, Resilience. If any issue is found, report it clearly. Otherwise confirm the checks look good.
